originality.rationale: The motivating complete-mobility paper proves two-robot resolvability on odd unicyclic graphs but does not classify the even sunlets. The 2014 sunlet study is of static metric dimension, not robot motion. The new contribution is a necessary and sufficient criterion and count for every three-core resolving configuration, proof that each is completely mobile, and the mobile obstruction at circumference four. Targeted alias, stronger-coverage and mathematical-record searches returned no equivalent; priority is qualified, not independently certified.
residual_risks: Unindexed or differently formulated mobile-landmark reconfiguration literature might contain the dynamic classification.
The raw cyclic gap-triple count can be regarded as elementary classical enumeration; its significance here is the new exact identification with all mobile core triples.
No independent peer or mathematical certification has been performed.

value.rationale: Completes a natural untreated even-parity branch of the new completely-mobile-resolving paradigm. It determines every core-only three-robot basis, counts them, proves connectivity under resolving-preserving token slides and proves full individual labelled robot patrols—not just existence or a numeric metric dimension. The four-cycle endpoint exhibits a genuine static-vs-mobile cost. It supplies interpretable necessary-and-sufficient structure rather than an arbitrary finite calculation.
